children: Gravity Chain said G token prices have shown significant discrepancies across exchanges, with spreads between some venues staying above 30% for several hours and peaking at more than 40%. According to Foresight News, the issue mainly stems from fragmented liquidity between the Gravity Alpha mainnet and Ethereum, as well as cross-chain limitations.

The team said it is developing a solution to help users move assets from the Gravity Alpha mainnet to Ethereum more quickly and efficiently. It added that it will continue to provide progress updates.

title: Gravity Chain Says G Token Price Gaps Exceeded 40% Across Exchanges
